description: Shot/cut detection for video, a faithful C# port of PySceneDetect's ContentDetector, AdaptiveDetector and ThresholdDetector with identical results. Decodes with ffmpeg (must be on PATH).

Optional fast path for ShotDetector: a bit-exact port of FFmpeg's yuv420p to BGR conversion, so ffmpeg can send raw yuv420p and only the pixels needed are converted. About 1.7x faster on 1080p video, identical results. LGPL-2.1-or-later, as the FFmpeg code it ports.
